pkgmetadata.longdescription: rocSHMEM is a GPU-centric communication runtime following the OpenSHMEM partitioned global address space model. Its distinguishing feature is that device code initiates its own transfers: puts, gets and collectives are called from inside a kernel rather than being marshalled by the host between kernel launches, which suits fine-grained communication that would otherwise force a launch boundary. It can run over an MPI bootstrap for multi-process work, or within a single node over HIP IPC.

use.flag: Enable the HIP IPC conduit for communication between GPUs on one node
Enable the SDMA transport conduit, which upstream documents as MI300X and newer; harmless but not useful on other parts
Use an external MPI implementation for host-side bootstrap and launching
Restrict the build to single-node support only
